source.citation: Perricone, E. PhD thesis, Universite de Grenoble, 2011-07-07
source.retrieval: Open-access PDF fetched with Microsoft Edge driven by Playwright after the HAL/Anubis proof-of-work interstitial; text extracted with pypdf (214 pages, 341,433 characters).
source.license_note: The numeric facts and their per-value reference letters are recorded; the PDF itself is not redistributed and stays in the git-ignored cache.
source.table_convention: Tableaux 5-9 are captioned 'a 25 C (sauf precision contraire)' and carry per-value reference letters (a-e). Tableau 12 carries neither a temperature note nor reference letters.

comparisons.note: The dataset row is colder (293.15 K) than the thesis value, and permittivity falls with rising temperature, so the two are compatible.
Rounding-level agreement at a 5 K higher temperature.
Independent corroboration of the PC backfill from a third document.
EC melts near 36 C, so a 25 C measurement implies a supercooled or extrapolated sample. The thesis value is a cross-check, not a replacement for the 313.15 K row.
The thesis value is itself an independent relay, so it corroborates the review value without promoting it to primary.

A 4.1-unit (12.7%) disagreement between two secondary documents. Neither side is a traced primary measurement. Per the dataset discipline the values are not averaged and the disagreement is opened as a conflict ticket for primary review.

summary.note: This is a cross-check pass. No dataset value was replaced or averaged; the single material disagreement is recorded as a ticket.
